newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil cos seen issuing $22 bln globally in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Brazil cos seen issuing $22 bln globally in 1997.

text.p: At least 12 Brazilian companies plan to issue new shares and debt totalling $22 billion next year in global markets, Sao Paulo's Association of Market Analysts (Abamec) said in a statement.
The association said Brazilian firms plan to issue $2 billion in shares and $20 billion in fixed-income assets on international markets in 1997. AbaIt did not name the firms.
The privatization of Brazilian state companies, coupled with concessions to operate gas, power distribution and cellular telephone services will generate another $10 billion in 1997, it said.
Local companies also expect to launch debentures and stocks in the domestic market totalling $20 billion next year, the statement added.
"The internal market has strong growth indicators," Abamec President Joao Bernacchio was quoted in the statement as saying.
